name: mialu-lsp
description: A language server for Mialu that shows the size of each struct above its definition and the type of a name when the pointer rests on it.

mialu.lsp.compilerPath.description: The path of mialuc, which works out the sizes. When it is empty, build/mialuc.exe in the folder of the workspace is used if it exists, and otherwise mialuc on the PATH.

mialu.lsp.structSizes.description: Show the size and the alignment of a struct above its definition.

mialu.lsp.constantValues.description: Show the value that the compiler worked out for a constant inline, after the :: of its definition, when it is not written as the value.

mialu.lsp.implicitCasts.description: Show the cast(Byte) that is not in the code, inline before a rune of the ASCII range that is given to a parameter of the type Byte.

mialu.lsp.typeHover.description: Show the type of a constant, a global variable, a parameter or a variable when the pointer rests on its name.
